notes.title: v0.96a
notes.content:
1) Music volume at game start is now set as per the volume game setting
2) Fixed a bug where sometimes two music tracks play while in the launcher screen
3) Fixed overlapping party and buff panels
4) Added the BattleField
[list]
[*] 	An instanced island reached via portals
[*] 	Various AI inhabit the island, and interact with one another
[*] 	Two factions so far to test the overall system, Kobolds and Settlers
[*] 	Settlers will raid the Kobold Camp when they decide to, and visa versa
[*] 	The AI scales according to the average player level in range
[*] 	Players can kill all the AI and the factions adjust accordingly
[*] 	BattleField entrance count is recorded, as are kills and deaths
[/list]
